title: Integrality tested on an affine cover of the target
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $Y=\bigcup_{\lambda\in L}V_\lambda$ be an affine open covering [def-weil-open-immersion]. Then $f$ is integral [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] if and only if every inverse image $f^{-1}(V_\lambda)$ is affine and every ring map
$$\mathcal O_Y(V_\lambda)\longrightarrow\mathcal O_X(f^{-1}(V_\lambda))$$
is integral, meaning that every element of its target satisfies a monic polynomial over its source. The covering is a set-indexed covering; no finiteness or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.
